headlines.title_en: Maximum mortgage term extended to 40 years; monthly payment for a Shenzhen 8-million-yuan home drops 4,313 yuan.
headlines.summary_en: According to Nandu, on August 28, the PBOC and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued the "Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Construction of a New Real Estate Development Model." To meet economic and social development needs, the Opinions extend the maximum term of individual housing loans from 30 years to 40 years, offering greater flexibility for both lenders and borrowers, with the specific term to be determined through consultation between homebuyers and commercial banks. So how much can homebuyers save on monthly payments if the loan term is extended to 40 years? According to estimates by Leyoujia Research Center, for a commercial residential property in Shenzhen with a total price of 8 million yuan, based on a 40-year pure commercial loan, the monthly payment will decrease by 4,313.47 yuan! Leyoujia Research Center noted that this new policy brings significant benefits. For homebuyers, extending the loan term can effectively reduce monthly payment pressure, enhance housing affordability, and alleviate the burden on first-time homebuyers and those seeking to upgrade.

headlines.title: 资本市场支持房地产新政落地 多措并举满足房企合理融资需求
headlines.summary: 【资本市场支持房地产新政落地 多措并举满足房企合理融资需求】中国证监会8月28日发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》。作为资本市场涉房地产各项融资业务的指引性文件，《意见》着力改革完善房地产企业股票、债券、资产支持证券（ABS）和不动产投资信托基金（REITs）等融资制度，满足房地产企业合理融资需求，助力构建房地产发展新模式。业内人士看来，随着《意见》与商业不动产REITs试点协同推进，资本市场支持房地产发展新模式的制度框架初步成形。

headlines.title_en: Capital market measures to support real estate take effect; multiple steps to meet developers' reasonable financing needs
headlines.summary_en: [Capital market supports new real estate policy implementation, multiple measures to meet reasonable financing needs of real estate enterprises] The CSRC issued the "Opinions on Capital Market Support for Building a New Real Estate Development Model" on August 28. As a guiding document for various real estate-related financing businesses in the capital market, the Opinions focus on reforming and improving financing systems for real estate enterprises, including stocks, bonds, asset-backed securities (ABS), and real estate investment trusts (REITs), to meet the reasonable financing needs of real estate enterprises and help build a new real estate development model. Industry insiders believe that with the coordinated advancement of the Opinions and commercial real estate REIT pilots, the institutional framework for capital market support of the new real estate development model is taking initial shape.

headlines.title_en: Key Takeaways from Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Symposium on August 28
headlines.summary_en: 1. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's keynote speech delivered a hawkish signal. He stated that the better-than-expected inflation reports this summer "do not indicate a meaningful improvement in the underlying trend." Unless the Fed becomes confident that underlying inflation is moving toward the target "clearly and at a sufficiently fast pace," "we still have work to do," he said. 2. In July, Warsh seemed to open the door to switching to another (potentially lower-rising) price measure, but this time he made clear that the Fed's 2% target is "a firm, fixed target, measured by the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index."

headlines.title_en: Experts: Presale-to-completed-home sales emphasize 'what you see is what you get,' fitting existing-home market logic
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 29: Yu Xiaofen, Dean of the China Housing and Real Estate Research Institute at Zhejiang University of Technology, noted that presale of completed homes emphasizes "what you see is what you get," aligning with the operational logic of the existing-home era. Over the past decades, China's housing supply-demand gap was large, and the presale system fully leveraged its advantages in accelerating housing supply and rapidly recovering funds, effectively alleviating housing supply shortages during the rapid urbanization phase and adapting to the industry's high-speed development needs. However, the current housing market landscape has fundamentally changed, with per capita housing floor area of urban residents exceeding 40 square meters, ample supply in both existing and increment markets, second-hand home sales accounting for over half of total sales, and the real estate development goal needing to shift from scale to quality. The market's main contradiction has shifted from "having or not" to "good or bad," and the industry's development logic has been completely restructured. headlines.title_en: Two-year U.S. Treasury yield rises over 11 basis points Friday; rate hike expectations firm after Waller's hawkish signal
headlines.summary_en: Friday (August 28) New York close: The US 10-year Treasury yield rose 4.18 basis points to 4.7180%. When Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech text was released, it fell to 4.6485%, hitting a daily low, then staged a long-tail W-shaped rebound, down 1.59 basis points for the week, overall in a declining state and showing a wide-bottom U-shape. The 2-year Treasury yield rose 11.14 basis points to 4.3434%, falling to 4.2135% in the 60 seconds before Warsh's speech text was released, hitting a daily low, then rising steadily, up 10.75 basis points for the week. Warsh's speech disrupted the earlier stability around the 4.2% level this week.

headlines.title_en: Spot gold falls about 3.1% amid hawkish Waller remarks
headlines.summary_en: Friday (August 28) New York close: Spot gold fell 3.08% to $4,457.57 per ounce. When Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech text was released at 22:00 Beijing time, it edged up to $4,631.61 per ounce, hitting a daily high, then broke out of the long intraday high-level narrow range and fell rapidly, down 3.22% for the week, with sustained narrow fluctuations from Monday until Warsh's speech, forming an intra-period top. Spot silver fell 4.17% to $66.3390 per ounce, down 3.89% for the week. COMEX copper futures fell 0.84% to $6.6330 per pound, down 0.73% for the week.

headlines.title_en: Domestic gold jewelry prices drop nearly 40 yuan per gram overnight
headlines.summary_en: On the morning of August 29 Beijing time, spot gold closed down 2.95%, falling below $4,500 per ounce to $4,453.67 per ounce. Overnight, Fed Chair Warsh delivered a speech at the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium. Warsh said that if US underlying inflation does not fall clearly and quickly enough toward the 2% target, the Fed "still has work to do." On August 29, multiple domestic branded gold jewelry prices fell sharply in unison. Laoshan Gold's gold jewelry was reported at 1,345 yuan/gram, down 39 yuan in a single day; Laofengxiang's gold jewelry was at 1,348 yuan/gram, down 36 yuan in a single day; Chow Sang Sang's gold jewelry was at 1,344 yuan/gram, up 37 yuan in a single day.

headlines.title_en: Dollar index rises over 0.5% this week; Waller strikes hawkish tone at Jackson Hole symposium
headlines.summary_en: Friday (August 28) New York close: The ICE US Dollar Index rose 0.54% to 99.698 points. When Fed Chair Warsh's speech text was released at 22:00 Beijing time, it edged down to 99.098 points, hitting a daily low, then rebounded instantly to near 99.600 points, up 0.90% for the week, maintaining a steady upward trend before Warsh's hawkish signal and accelerating after his speech. The Bloomberg Dollar Index rose 0.39% to 1,198.98 points, up 0.62% for the week, trading in a range of 1,190.85-1,199.43 points.

headlines.title: 沃什杰克逊霍尔首秀偏鹰：通胀仍居首位 主张让美联储“更安静”
headlines.summary: 【沃什杰克逊霍尔首秀偏鹰：通胀仍居首位 主张让美联储“更安静”】当地时间8月28日，美联储主席凯文·沃什（KevinWarsh）在怀俄明州杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会上发表讲话。面对仍高于目标的通胀，沃什明确表示，美联储当前的首要任务仍然是价格稳定，并为未来数月进一步加息保留空间。“通胀仍然高于我们2%的目标，因此，美联储当前的主要关注点应该放在价格上。”沃什表示。尽管今年夏季公布的PCE和CPI数据好于预期，但“这些数据并没有告诉我，基础通胀趋势已经出现实质性改善”。

headlines.title_en: Waller's Jackson Hole debut leans hawkish: inflation remains top priority, advocates a 'quieter' Fed
headlines.summary_en: [Warsh's Jackson Hole debut leans hawkish: Inflation remains top priority, advocating for a 'quieter' Fed] On August 28 local time, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a speech at the Jackson Hole global central bank symposium in Wyoming. Facing inflation still above target, Warsh made clear that the Fed's current top priority remains price stability, preserving room for further rate hikes in the coming months. "Inflation is still above our 2% target, so the Fed's main focus should remain on prices," Warsh said. Although PCE and CPI data this summer came in better than expected, "these data do not tell me that the underlying inflation trend has shown substantial improvement."

headlines.title: 顺丰控股：加快推进智能装备和AI应用场景落地
headlines.summary: 顺丰控股8月28日在业绩说明会表示，展望2026下半年，国内端，公司将继续深挖消费多元细分场景，深度服务B端企业转型升级，持续加深经营护城河；国际端，公司会紧抓中国企业品牌和产能出海机遇，加快发展第二增长曲线业务；同时，加快推进智能装备和AI应用场景落地，将技术优势转化为长期经营效益。综合来看，下半年外部环境仍存在油价等多重不确定性，公司将保持经营策略定力，持续精益管理，致力于交付稳健的营收和利润结果。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: SF Holding: Accelerating deployment of smart equipment and AI application scenarios
headlines.summary_en: SF Holding stated at its August 28 results briefing that looking ahead to the second half of 2026, on the domestic front, the company will continue to dig deeper into diversified consumer scenarios, deeply serve B-end enterprise transformation and upgrading, and continue to deepen its operational moat; on the international front, the company will seize opportunities from Chinese enterprises' brand and capacity going overseas, accelerating the development of its second growth curve business; meanwhile, it will accelerate the implementation of smart equipment and AI application scenarios, converting technological advantages into long-term operational benefits. Overall, in the second half of the year, the external environment still contains multiple uncertainties such as oil prices. The company will maintain strategic focus in its operating strategy, continue lean management, and commit to delivering stable revenue and profit results. (Securities Times)
